conversations.offer: My detailed description of the acoustic cadence and presence during our initial encounter.
conversations.request: Your professional evaluation of whether that encounter was a human performance or something else.

conversations.say: Arden, Veridian's archive records and my letter packet establish the baseline. Let's make sure our public framing recognizes the human origin without pretending the ledger doesn't have gaps.

conversations.say: Jules, you've stated your case for succession. I'm prepared to support a worthy steward, provided you commit to absolute accountability toward the infrastructure and people who built this work.

public_statement: Fifteen years of journalism began with a human voice and a real room, even if memory and performance helped polish the legend along the way. Let's protect the truth we built without pretending we never needed editors or scrapers to keep it alive.

commitments.promise: I will share my precise description of the initial encounter in exchange for your professional acoustic and performance evaluation.
